subject: tools/miniunifieddb_cognition_store_v1.py

finding.summary: resolve_prepare_binding validates current generation and task hash but does not reconstruct and compare the persisted turn binding digest or boot binding digest from the exact fields it returns.
finding.counterexample: If a stored turn field such as workspace_digest/slots or a stored boot field such as zero_identity_digest/grf_digest is modified while the old binding_digest is retained, the current read path has no explicit canonical-digest equality check before returning the modified material.
finding.authority_risk: A corrupted or improperly mutated MiniUnifiedDB row could be reintroduced into pre-inference cognition ancestry without the binding digest detecting the mutation on read. This does not create a second authority, but it weakens the intended fail-closed provenance fence.

required_repair: reconstruct boot binding material from persisted schema/generation/all cognition digests/provenance and require sha256(material)==binding_digest

reconstruct turn binding material from persisted schema/generation/causal_turn_id/boot binding/task/workspace/slots/contradiction/provenance/required_zero_mode and require sha256(material)==binding_digest
validate canonical JSON list fields before digest reconstruction
add deterministic tamper regressions for at least workspace_digest and zero_identity_digest

temporal_authority: pre-inference admission -> inference -> deterministic gate -> commit or explicit no-commit -> final UCF runtime receipt -> post-turn binding

unusual_experiment.note: Source review/counterexample only; no additional unusual experiment consumed.

next_gate: Repair read-time binding digest verification in the single landed cognition store, then integrate that resolver into the retained pipeline_cognitive_fabric_admit producer and obtain actually-started authorized isolated exact-source execution.
